learning_outcomes.text: Load tables into the Excel Data Model and create relationships
Distinguish calculated columns from measures and choose correctly
Write foundational DAX using SUM, CALCULATE and basic time intelligence
Explain row context and filter context at a working level
Build a star-schema model that drives a PivotTable report

integrative_case: A finance team has a wide sales export and separate date, product and region tables; build a star-schema Data Model with relationships and a small set of DAX measures that feed a PivotTable for monthly margin by region.
